## Install with one exe

- The exe now includes the .NET runtime, so nothing else needs to be installed.
- Run it and choose Yes to install it for your account: it goes to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\KeyboardLayoutSwitcher`,
  gets a Start menu shortcut, starts with Windows, and appears in Settings > Apps for uninstalling.
- Running a newer exe updates the installed copy.

## Improvements

- When an app running as administrator has focus, the switch is applied as soon as you move to another window.
- Optional diagnostic log (Settings > Options).
- An unreadable settings file is kept as `config.bad.json` instead of being overwritten.
- Start with Windows follows the exe when it is moved.
- The tray icon is sharp at any display scaling and numbers layouts that share a country code ("US", "US2").
- New app icon.
